tools.name: check_email_domain
tools.description: Check everything about a domain's email setup in one call: SPF, DMARC, MX, DKIM on common selectors, domain blocklists, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI. Use it for a general question such as "is email set up correctly for example.com".

tools.name: check_spf
tools.description: Check a domain's SPF record: whether it exists and is valid, how many of the 10 allowed DNS lookups it uses, and how its all mechanism treats mail from servers that are not listed.

tools.name: check_dkim
tools.description: Check a domain's DKIM public keys in DNS. With a selector (the s= tag of a DKIM-Signature header), checks that selector's key; without one, probes common selector names. Finding no key on common names does not prove DKIM is missing: selectors cannot be listed from DNS.

tools.name: check_dmarc
tools.description: Check a domain's DMARC record: whether it exists and is valid, its policy (none, quarantine or reject), alignment, and where reports are sent.

tools.name: lookup_mx
tools.description: Look up a domain's MX records (its incoming mail servers), their IP addresses and reverse DNS. DNS only: it does not connect to the mail servers.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: Look up DNS records of a name. Type ALL (the default) queries A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA and CAA; any single type can be asked for. An IP address gives its reverse DNS (PTR) lookup.

tools.name: check_blacklist
tools.description: Check whether an IP address or a domain is listed on public DNS blocklists (DNSBLs). A domain is checked on domain blocklists only; to check a mail server, give its IP address.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_domain · Private data: check_spf, check_dmarc, lookup_mx, dns_lookup · Public sink: check_email_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_domain · Private data: check_spf, check_dmarc, lookup_mx, dns_lookup · Public sink: check_email_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
